steps: Stop new tasks and disconnect only the bound Jenkins Node
Archive only redacted ci-evidence; independently verify artifact seal/run/build/digests
DELETE the exact Pod with UID precondition and 30-second grace; never delete by broad label alone
Wait at most 90 seconds and inspect the bound runtime domain, including descendants
Only after processes are proven absent, remove the exact run's remoting Secret and Node registration
Remove only the run's disposable fixture; verify temporary workspace is gone
Remove newly created dedicated SA and allow NetworkPolicy only after proving no run is using them
controllerLoss: noReconnect plus Pod deadline600s; trusted operator resumes exact-run reconciliation
nodeLoss: CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE; no force delete, no Node-name/token reuse until runtime stop or reliable node isolation proven
